threads.body: this was always supposed to be startswith `java-`, but apparently was matching every modules with `java` in the name
threads.hunk:
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@
 
 for dir in $(find instrumentation -name "*.java" | grep library/src/main/java | sed 's#/[^/]*$##' | sort -u); do
 
-  module_name=$(echo "$dir" | sed 's#.*/\([^/]*\)/library/src/main/java/.*#\1#')
+  module_name=$(echo "$dir" | sed 's#.*/\([^/]*\)/library/src/main/java[0-9]*/.*#\1#')
 
-  if [[ "$module_name" =~ java-* ]]; then
+  if [[ "$module_name" =~ ^java- ]]; then

threads.body:
in the meantime, we've developed a convention where we strip trailing `-java` from package names, e.g. in these modules:

- graphql-java
- openai-java
- opensearch-java
- vertx-rx-java

which seems pretty reasonable, so just updating the enforcement to match that convention
threads.hunk:
@@ -42,7 +63,8 @@ for dir in $(find instrumentation -name "*.java" | grep library/src/main/java |
     exit 1
   fi
 
-  simple_module_name=$(echo "$module_name" | sed 's/-[0-9.]*$//' | sed 's/-//g')
+  # convention: if module ends with -java (followed by version), remove -java from the package name
+  simple_module_name=$(echo "$module_name" | sed 's/-[0-9.]*$//' | sed 's/-java$//' | sed 's/-//g')
